protocol: fern-undistorted-v1; public calibrated cameras; training-only COLMAP triangulation
additional_regularization: only uniform inverse-depth L1 in positive-lambda arm
depth_supervision: train-only aligned Small priors in positive-lambda arm
resampling: OpenCV INTER_LINEAR, alpha=0, centered principal point, focal guard=1.001
evaluation_gt: Same six image names, resampled into a separate pinhole protocol
comparability: Do not interpret differences from legacy distorted-GT metrics as algorithm gains

comparison.schedule: fixed weight after warmup; no decay or per-view tuning
comparison.normalizer: per-image median inverse Z of observed train SfM anchors
comparison.loss: valid-pixel arithmetic mean absolute inverse-Z error / normalizer
comparison.mask: fixed positive target and 2px border; detached alpha>=0.5 and finite positive ED

prior.alignment: per-view unweighted OLS affine inverse-depth to observed train SfM inverse Z; no fallback
